description: Every row-level change this platform observed in an official register, a mirrored series or a tracker since a date, newest first, with the value on both sides and the size of the move. This answers "what moved since I last looked" in one call. Magnitudes carry their own unit and are not comparable across units — a water plant’s cubic metres a day are not megawatts.
